title: Re-run the suites so each stamps the commit it proved
ask: The stored suite results predate the change that made runs stamp the commit they proved, so their age is unknowable rather than large. Re-run the four suites from the Engineering page so each stamps a commit, then confirm the freshness column reads a number instead of 'unknown'.
first_action: Press Run on each of the four suites on #/pillar/engineering and watch the 'how far behind main' column.
